items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Gene Quill, all these great, great players that we were so honored to be able to work with

ctx.x: But, yeah I think it was. Gene Quill, all these great, great players that we were so honored to be able to work with, and just even having Quincy write and all these people that wrote for it, it was a thrill for us to be able to do that. Because that’s what it’s all about you know, about doing something new. And people sort of like one thing that they’ve heard and they get attached to it, and they want you to do it all the time. You know like we don’t do “I’m Forever Blowing Bubbles” anymore really, and we don’t…
